about: Shown averages (step 38, decisions 91-93, docs/phase-2/step-19-grade-rules.md). Generated by tools/fixtures/shown-averages.mjs with exact integer arithmetic; do not edit. Formats: a = afronden (half-up), k = afkappen (towards zero), digit = decimals. Values use a decimal point; the UI shows a comma. "exact" is the reduced fraction; null = no average (all weights 0). "trap" lists the formats a naive double implementation (Math.round/floor of avg * 10^d) gets wrong. Groups: shown values per student, their mean at afronden 1 and % onvoldoende (shown < 5.5) at afronden 0.
